title: HR team directory: batched loaders that still query once per employee
name: Team directory loaders

questions.prompt: The team directory page takes 6-8 seconds for our larger departments, and the DBA sent us a slow-query digest. It shows hundreds of 'SELECT ... FROM reviews WHERE employee_id = ANY($1)' and 'FROM employees WHERE id = ANY($1)' calls per page view, each with a single id in the array. We added the batch loaders exactly to avoid this. Fix directory.ts so the tests pass.
